guiding_policy: The user must be able to set up a new tracked habit in under two minutes without reading documentation. Defaults are aggressively opinionated; advanced options are hidden behind a single 'more' affordance.
desired_outcome: After this ships, a first-time user can open the habit-tracker, name a habit, and confirm a daily cadence in three taps. The user observes that the first screen contains exactly the choices needed to begin, and no others.
desired_solution: A first-run wizard with three steps: name, cadence (daily / weekly / custom), reminder window (morning / evening / none). 'More options' on each step reveals advanced controls (custom recurrence, multiple reminders, tags). Save is implicit on the last step; no submit button.
metrics: OMTM: setup-completion rate within first session ≥0.7 (rolling 30-day cohort, vs prior baseline of 0.4). Secondary: median time-to-first-habit ≤120s. Decision rule: if completion rate <0.7 for 2 consecutive cohorts, restructure the wizard step ordering.
